name: Rodeur Errant
description: Relais de communication transmettant les messages entre unités dispersées dans les zones de brouillage.

subject.archetype: Les Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture – Scrap-Punk Combat Communicator

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavily patched asymmetric mining space suit, welded sign plates, duct tape, exposed cables, reinforced knee pads, communication relay backpack with multiple jury‑rigged antennae and blinking status LEDs
loadout.arsenal: Militarized mining harpoon rifle with exposed copper coils and a plasma torch sidearm, improvised IEM coil launcher strapped to forearm

attitude.behavior: Combat stance with weapon raised, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring, ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Intense focus, fierce determination, adrenaline‑fueled aggression

palette_names.name: Hot Plasma Blue
palette_names.role: energy accents, plasma bolts, and glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dynamic side‑lit by plasma bursts, volumetric smoke, flickering industrial lights, harsh shadows, high‑contrast OSL reflections on metal surfaces

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation crossroads junction, corroded corrugated metal walls, improvised barricades built from cargo containers and scrap, dense smoke, distant stars
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Plasma rounds impacting walls, ricocheting sparks and debris raining down, thick smoke swirling, flickering plasma glow, occasional muzzle flash, dust particles illuminated by plasma light
